text: The tool offers unprecedented granularity with daily-updated sub-seasonal drought outlooks at district and 5 km grid resolution. It leverages NIWA35 deep learning to enhance local predictive skill and integrates with the NZDI for consistent drought monitoring. The ensemble percentile framing supports risk-based planning, and the tool is co-designed with MPI for operational relevance. It is supported by NeSI's HPC resources for scalable model development.
